fields.title: Include or exclude rows from the reference table
fields.description: Includes or excludes all rows from the reference table in the resulting table from the first input.

fields.title: Data column (in first input)
fields.description: The column from the table to be filtered that should be used for comparison.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Reference column (in second input)
fields.description: The column from the filter table that should be used for comparison.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Update domains of all columns
fields.description: Advanced setting to enable recomputation of the domains of all columns in the output table such that the domains' bounds exactly match the bounds of the data in the output table.
